title: 第11章 极境之威第12章 开始抢人了
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
柳梦瑶激动道：“哈哈，这也太刺激了！”
秦峰催促道：“不要废话，赶紧收拾东西，撤！”
二人立即将商世杰跟袁武储物戒中的灵石收走，然后消失不见。
主峰大殿，楼万里对众人道：“我感受到阵法的波动，那蒙面大盗又出手了！”
其他人眼睛一亮，林青河道：“快，我倒要看看哪个兔崽子胆子这么大，光天化日，居然打劫同门。”
一众长老凌空飞渡，直接飞往影剑峰，下面的弟子看着心惊胆战。
上一次宗主跟几大长老同时行动，是多少年前的事了？
难道是魔族入侵了？各弟子都做好了战斗准备，这次宗门要发生大事了。
众人来到影剑锋的小道上，就看到昏迷的商世杰跟袁武。
三长老将商世杰唤醒，屡次在他影剑峰发生这种事情，他面子上也有些挂不住，没好气的问道：
“究竟是谁干的？看清了吗？”
商世杰迷迷糊糊的醒来，看到宗主跟一众长老全都在这里，吓得一哆嗦。
唯唯诺诺道：“是两个人，没看清面貌！”
三长老没好气道：“废物，让你平时不好好修炼。”
众人又将袁武唤醒，袁武居然受了不轻的伤，询问他情况，跟商世杰的回答一样。
最多的信息就是两个蒙面人，其他一概不知。
对方出手太快，不给他们任何反应的机会。
林青河看了一下袁武身上的伤，淡淡一笑道：“我知道是谁了！”
众长老都一脸好奇的看着林青河，林青河没有直接回答。
而是问道：“你们觉得用木棍能在瞬间将袁武击成重伤，让他毫无还手之力，剑技要达到何等程度？”

楼万里道：“如果是同境界的话，至少也要化境，如果境界比他低，那就……”
他不用往下说，众人已经都明了，那是传说中的极境，根本不可能有人达到那个境界。
三长老道：“宗主，你就别卖关子了，到底是谁呀？”
林青河道：“据我所知，前两天老四藏书阁的一块四级测技石被斩成了飞灰，有这事吧！”
四长老道：“什么都瞒不过宗主的眼睛！”
楼万里道：“我知道是谁了，原来是那个小祸害。”
说完他一脸同情的看着三长老，这下心里平衡多了。
他有些不敢自信的问道：“难道他真的将剑技修到了极境？”
之前在藏书阁，他以为秦峰只是将剑技修到了化境，因为测技石年久失修才被斩灭。
现在听掌门的意思好像不是这么回事！
林青河道：“去问问不就知道了！”
穆无双看到几人在那打哑谜，她的暴脾气一下就上来了：“我说你们几个老家伙，卖什么关子？”
“有话不能直说吗？急死个人！”
林青河一笑道：“就是你的宝贝徒弟秦峰啊！”
穆无双一脸愕然：“我家老二？不可能，我昨天刚问过，不是他！”
林青河道：“师妹，我们打个赌如何，如果我说中了，你就答应我一个条件。”
“如果我说错了，我可以答应你一个条件，任何条件都行。”
穆无双面露警惕道：“你不会又打我的主意吧？不行，我不想找道侣！”
林青河面露失望之色，但又道：“好，那就除了这个条件，其他的可以吧？”
穆无双道：“行啊，你可别后悔，我听说你最近去秘境得到一把仙器宝剑，就用它做赌注吧。”
content_en:
Liu Mengyao said excitedly: "Haha, this is so exciting!"
Qin Feng urged: "Don't talk nonsense, pack your things quickly and evacuate!"
The two immediately took away the spiritual stones from Shang Shijie and Yuan Wu's storage rings, and then disappeared.
In the main hall of the main peak, Lou Wanli said to everyone: "I felt the fluctuation of the formation, and the masked thief took action again!"
The eyes of the others lit up, and Lin Qinghe said: "Quick, I want to see which bastard is so bold as to rob a fellow sect member in broad daylight."
A group of elders flew through the sky and flew directly to Shadow Sword Peak. The disciples below looked at them with fear.
How many years ago was it last time the sect leader and several elders acted at the same time?
Could it be that the demons invaded? All the disciples are ready for battle. Something big is going to happen to the sect this time.
When everyone came to the path of Ying Jianfeng, they saw Shang Shijie and Yuan Wu who were unconscious.
The third elder woke up Shang Shijie. This happened to him many times at Shadow Sword Peak. He was a little worried about his face and asked angrily:
"Who did it? Did you see clearly?"
Shang Shijie woke up in a daze and trembled with fear when he saw the sect leader and all the elders here.
He said solemnly: "It's two people, I didn't see their faces clearly!"
The third elder said angrily: "This waste makes you not practice well."
Everyone woke Yuan Wu up again, and Yuan Wu was actually seriously injured. They asked him about his condition and gave the same answer as Shang Shijie.
The most information is about the two masked men, and nothing else is known.
The opponent struck too quickly, not giving them any chance to react.
Lin Qinghe looked at Yuan Wu's injuries, smiled lightly and said, "I know who it is!"
All the elders looked at Lin Qinghe with curiosity, but Lin Qinghe did not answer directly.
Instead, he asked: "Do you think Yuan Wu can be seriously injured with a wooden stick in an instant, leaving him unable to fight back? How high should your sword skills be?"
Lou Wanli said: "If they are in the same realm, they should at least transform into the realm. If the realm is lower than him, then..."
He didn't need to go on, everyone already understood that it was the legendary extreme state, and it was impossible for anyone to reach that state.
The third elder said: "Sect Master, please stop showing off. Who is it?"
Lin Qinghe said: "As far as I know, a fourth-level skill-testing stone in Laosi's Library was chopped into fly ash two days ago. Is this possible?"
The fourth elder said: "Nothing can be hidden from the eyes of the sect master!"
Lou Wanli said: "I know who it is, it turns out to be that little scourge."
After saying that, he looked at the third elder with sympathy, feeling much more balanced now.
He asked a little unconfidently: "Did he really cultivate his sword skills to the extreme?"
Before in the Library Pavilion, he thought Qin Feng had only cultivated his sword skills to the realm of transformation, and was destroyed because the skill-testing stone was in disrepair for a long time.
Now it seems that this is not what the leader means!
Lin Qinghe said: "If you go and ask, you will know!"
Mu Wushuang saw a few people playing riddles there, and her temper suddenly rose: "I said you old guys, why do you care?"
"Can't you just say something directly? I'm so worried!"
Lin Qinghe smiled and said: "That's your precious apprentice Qin Feng!"
Mu Wushuang looked stunned: "My second son? Impossible, I just asked yesterday, it's not him!"
Lin Qinghe said: "Junior sister, how about we make a bet. If I win, you must agree to one condition."
"If I was wrong, I can promise you a condition, any condition will do."
Mu Wushuang looked wary and said, "You won't try to trick me again, will you? No, I don't want to find a Taoist companion!"
Lin Qinghe looked disappointed, but then said: "Okay, except for this condition, what else can I do?"
Mu Wushuang said: "Okay, don't regret it. I heard that you recently went to a secret realm and got an immortal sword. Just use it as a bet."
